flows:

Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Complete the registered journey in order and check each requested outcome.
For keyboard operation, use the declared arrow keys and Escape as needed.
Do not use a substitute destination or control.
If a required control or outcome is inaccessible, @v16:"report the exact step that failed".
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open “About” from keyboard focus or with Arrow Down and follow “YC Interview Guide”.
Confirm the public destination /interviews.
